past_7_days.description:

This video captures the Marines' flawless precision and discipline as they perform their signature silent drill routine in front of our home crowd in Houston.

The Silent Drill Platoon is one of the most elite ceremonial units in the United States military, known for their perfectly synchronized movements and rifle handling without any verbal commands. Their performance was a powerful tribute to our nation's servicemen and women, and the entire stadium was captivated by their skill and dedication.

This Thursday Night Football game was made even more special by this incredible halftime show that honored our military heroes. The Marines' precision and professionalism perfectly embodied the values of excellence and teamwork that we strive for as the Houston Texans.

past_7_days.description:
Texans legend Andre Johnson receives the life-changing call from Cris Carter informing him of his Pro Football Hall of Fame induction. An emotional moment you have to see.

Watch the incredible moment Houston Texans legend Andre Johnson gets 'The Knock' from Pro Football Hall of Fame selector Cris Carter, officially notifying him of his induction into the Pro Football Hall of Fame Class of 2024. This emotional and historic moment captures Johnson's genuine reaction to achieving football's highest honor. Andre Johnson spent 12 legendary seasons with the Houston Texans from 2003-2014, becoming the franchise's all-time leading receiver and one of the greatest wide receivers in NFL history. Johnson's 1,012 career receptions, 14,185 receiving yards, and 64 touchdowns with the Texans made him a cornerstone of the franchise and a beloved figure in H-Town. The seven-time Pro Bowl selection and two-time All-Pro was known for his incredible hands, route-running precision, and leadership both on and off the field. This historic phone call represents the culmination of an outstanding NFL career and cements Johnson's legacy among the greatest players to ever wear a Texans uniform. A truly special moment for Andre Johnson, the Houston Texans organization, and all of Texans Nation who watched number 80 dominate for over a decade.

current_fy.description:
Texans legend Andre Johnson receives the life-changing call from Cris Carter informing him of his Pro Football Hall of Fame induction. An emotional moment you have to see.

Watch the incredible moment Houston Texans legend Andre Johnson gets 'The Knock' from Pro Football Hall of Fame selector Cris Carter, officially notifying him of his induction into the Pro Football Hall of Fame Class of 2024. This emotional and historic moment captures Johnson's genuine reaction to achieving football's highest honor. Andre Johnson spent 12 legendary seasons with the Houston Texans from 2003-2014, becoming the franchise's all-time leading receiver and one of the greatest wide receivers in NFL history. Johnson's 1,012 career receptions, 14,185 receiving yards, and 64 touchdowns with the Texans made him a cornerstone of the franchise and a beloved figure in H-Town. The seven-time Pro Bowl selection and two-time All-Pro was known for his incredible hands, route-running precision, and leadership both on and off the field. This historic phone call represents the culmination of an outstanding NFL career and cements Johnson's legacy among the greatest players to ever wear a Texans uniform. A truly special moment for Andre Johnson, the Houston Texans organization, and all of Texans Nation who watched number 80 dominate for over a decade.
